text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Oil minister says Iraq will supply southern Europe with gas once trade sanctions are lifted.
- Iraq will submit its food distribution plan to the U.N. chief next Monday.
- Cuba sends a delegation to attend the 29th anniversary of July 17, 1968 revolution.
- President Saddam Hussein receives congratulations on the anniversary of July revolution from senior Iraqi state and Baath party officials.
